properties.name: Ancient Near East
properties.description: The biblical creation account was given to Israel in the Ancient Near East, contrasting with pagan creation myths of surrounding cultures.
properties.archaeology: Creation accounts from Mesopotamia (Enuma Elish) differ significantly from Genesis in theology and cosmology

properties.name: Land of Israel (Future Promise)
properties.description: God commanded mankind to fill the earth and subdue it. The land of Canaan would later become central to God's plan.

properties.name: Mesopotamia (Cradle of Civilization)
properties.popup: Region of earliest human civilization - Genesis 1:26-28
properties.description: Archaeological evidence shows earliest complex civilizations emerged in the Fertile Crescent, consistent with biblical narrative.
